method: Static scan of openvino_language_model.xml only (Python xml.etree). No model load, no .bin access, no compilation. All layer elements in document order; ordinal is the 0-based index among all layer elements; only Const layers are considered slots. offset/size are read from the layer data element and stored as null when absent (never substituted with 0). Routed slot = gate|up|down x weight|scale|zp, counted only when: type=Const; name contains '.mlp.experts.'; name does not contain 'shared_expert'; weight ends with gate_proj|up_proj|down_proj; scale ends with /scale; zp ends with /zero_point. fq_weights, subtract, convert, MatMul, and shared_expert consts ignored. Block index from 'layers.<digits>.' in the name.
eligibility_statement: This is a static name/offset co-occurrence scan. It is NOT compiled eligibility and no ELIGIBLE verdict is claimed.

naming_diagnostics.note: No Const layer name contains '.mlp.experts.'. The routed-expert storage in these IRs is named self.model.language_model.layers.<L>.mlp.{gate,up,down}_proj.weight[/scale|/zero_point] and an extra self.model.language_model.layers.<L>.experts.down_proj[/scale|/zero_point] trio, plus packed __module...experts/prim::ListUnpack/VariadicSplit.* gate/up blobs (no proj-suffixed scale/zp names). Under the literal protocol these are not counted anywhere.
